clips.title: The story
paras: Ward Restocking is a task in the Arathi Highlands where travelers assist Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall. With the outpost's infirmary running short on vital elixirs, couriers are dispatched to retrieve neglected supplies from Apothecary Jorell's lab at Go'Shek Farm.

At the Horde settlement of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, Doctor Gregory Victor tends to the wounded and ailing in the outpost's medical ward. Keeping the infirmary functional demands a regular supply of remedies, antidotes, and elixirs, which are usually provided by the Forsaken apothecary stationed nearby. When these deliveries stall, Victor must enlist capable travelers to step in and keep the clinic stocked.

Apothecary Jorell conducts his alchemical experiments out of a cramped, poorly-ventilated shack at Go'Shek Farm, south and west of Hammerfall. According to Doctor Victor, Jorell's absence is nothing out of the ordinary; the eccentric Forsaken chemist is notorious for either ignoring his official duties or accidentally succumbing to his own noxious concoctions. Couriers sent to retrieve the packaged tonics are expected to find the medicine waiting, regardless of whether Jorell is present.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.
If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.
Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
